law.law: Colorado Revised Statutes, section 24-80-904, State flag

meta.name: Colorado
note: From the statute: every size, in section 24-80-904 of the Colorado Revised Statutes 2024, read in the legislature's uncertified printout. Its history line gives the acts of 1911, 1929 and 1964. Reading the one-fifth as the distance from the staff to the C's nearest edge, and the opening's lines as straight, is this file's. The Commons drawing agrees.

From the statute too: the blue is the blue field's of the national flag and the red is the national flag's, so both match united-states.kdl, which says where they come from. FOTW says the 1929 act set those colors.
From the Commons drawing: the gold, #ffd700. The statute says only a golden disk, and no other source read gives a shade.
